**Chi-Kuang Yeh**\
*Georgia State University*

## Description

This is the repo for the course STAT 8310 - Bayesian Data Analysis offered at Georgia State University in Spring 2027.

Course website: <https://chikuang.github.io/teaching/2027S_stat8310/>

The `2027S` branch starts from the previous offering. Dates and course arrangements are tentative.

## Build and publish

Run `quarto render --to pdf`, then `quarto render --to html --no-clean` from this directory to retain both formats in `_book/`. The project uses frozen results for unchanged chapters. Publish `_book/` to `teaching/2027S_stat8310/` in `chikuang/chikuang.github.io`.
